fusions.name: Rote Quiver
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Flawless Spread
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 20 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Practised Renock
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Muscle Memory
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that fails to crit is rolled again, and the second roll stands.
